title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1990-09-14
lineage: Master Cassette > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: OTS AUD: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > patched thru one Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX90/100, with no Dolby.

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with tape cuts but captures the high‑energy ’90s performance.
ai_review.review: The show delivers a punchy, energetic vibe that many fans of the early ‘90s era will appreciate, even though the audience source isn’t pristine. The sound is acceptable overall, but tape‑cut glitches and limited clarity keep it from being a perfect listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Review gives 4 stars, praising the performance while noting recording flaws; weighted estimate yields ~4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is okay for an audience tape but suffers from tape cuts and could be clearer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and lively ’90s set that fans enjoy, though no specific song highlights are mentioned.
